lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments observed. Spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-torso with slight compression observed as the lines approach the posterior haunches.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the sixth vertical line from the anterior position, splitting in the lower ventral third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is abbreviated, terminating at mid-shoulder. The final three posterior lines show significant discontinuity, transitioning from solid lines to dashed segments and spots before the rump.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 6-8 white spots is localized on the upper hind limb and lower haunch area, posterior to the final vertical torso line.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four distinct spots on the upper thigh align to form a semi-linear diagonal path sloping from the upper rump toward the knee joint.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct white spots are visible on the malar/cheek region. A prominent white transverse band is visible at the base of the neck/upper chest area.
